text: {"components": [{"type": "claim", "quote": "He was the president of the Basel-Stadt cantonal council from 2021 until he was elected to serve on the Federal Council in late 2023.", "gist": "Beat Jans served as Basel-Stadt cantonal council president until late 2023 when elected to Federal Council"}, {"type": "number", "quote": "13 December 2023", "gist": "Date of election to Federal Council"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "United Federal Assembly", "gist": "Swiss legislative body that elected Beat Jans"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Federal Council", "gist": "Swiss federal executive body"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Federal Department of Justice and Police (FDJP)", "gist": "Swiss federal department responsible for justice and police matters"}, {"type": "obligation", "quote": "The FDJP deals with crime, asylum issues, internal security and the coexistence of people of different nationalities.", "gist": "FDJP is responsible for crime, asylum, internal security, and national coexistence"}, {"type": "date", "quote": "January 2024", "gist": "Month when Beat Jans assumed leadership of FDJP"}]}
